name: Braille Constellation Field
description: A field of raised dots covering the earth like Braille — each constellation a sentence written across the landscape — readable only by touch, telling the sky's stories to those who walk the lines barefoot.
prompt: Vast field covered in raised tactile dots forming Braille constellations across landscape, each star a raised dome, lines connecting them form sentences in universal Braille, blind and sighted people walk barefoot reading the sky's stories with their feet, fingertips tracing constellation lines, night sky above mirrors the ground patterns perfectly, moonlight casts shadows making dots readable visually too, profound accessibility concept, peaceful starlit atmosphere, 8k, human scale perspective
caption:
The stars wrote their stories in Braille — so everyone could read them. ⭐👣

Walk the constellations. Feel the universe tell its tales.
